release_change.objective_exposure: 62/62 numbered objectives have at least one standard MCQ exposure

workflow: Run the 16-question diagnostic once if no baseline exists.
Study the lowest diagnostic domain with retrieval-before-reveal cards.
Use Exam + Stretch as the default standard-practice filter.
Commit confidence before answering; prioritize high-confidence misses for repair.
Review why all four options win or lose on every released standard question.
Use Bellringers separately as non-exam-representative integrative drills.
Re-test later rather than immediately repeating the same set.

question_bank_expansion_target.originality_rule: Questions are authored from public scope/primary standards and audited knowledge, never from exam dumps, live-item recollections, leaked banks, or commercial-question wording/templates.

GitHub Pages workflow run 32996762272 verified the live v1.15 runtime at SHA 4f97700f38346791c29d8ec511616ef5db5f5b98 with 335 standard questions, 1 Bellringer, and a released-only artifact. This is not a mathematical guarantee of perpetual infallibility or a guarantee of passing the live adaptive CISSP exam.
known_non_blocking_limitations: Browser-local progress does not sync across devices unless exported manually.
The diagnostic is intentionally a routing signal, not an exam-readiness prediction.
Blueprint subtopic labels are paraphrased; the ISC2 source remains authoritative for exact wording.

Legacy Q-001..Q-056 predate explicit enriched subtopic tags, so enriched-subtopic exposure measures explicit metadata coverage rather than proving that an untagged concept has never appeared in practice.
Question difficulty is an authoring scale until sufficient real learner-response data exists for empirical calibration.
